roadmap.title: Story mode on Welcome to the Jungle
roadmap.description: Play the base campaign on the lowest story difficulty and clear the story achievements as they come: tutorial, first tool, first fire, first shelter and save, safe water, human meat and a tribesman kill, the snowman packages and Wilson, the green mushroom, the ayahuasca brew and the cure. Keep a manual save at the research lab camp before the final ritual so both endings and the gold sack can be finished from one run.

roadmap.title: Free-play, collectibles and grinds
roadmap.description: Once the story save is free, finish every cumulative or exploration goal: reading 50 collectibles, unlocking 60 map places, travelling 64 km, cultivating 12 plants, capping one skill, the full metal armor set, the four aquatic and predator hunting counters, the ailment and leech counters, and all 7 challenges.

roadmap.title: Endurance and difficulty runs
roadmap.description: Start fresh runs for the difficulty and survival achievements. Stack Keeper of the flame, I made it, Pacifist and Vegan! on one King of the Jungle save, then complete a separate deathless story run on Green Hell difficulty.

roadmap.title: Animal husbandry
roadmap.description: Build an animal pen, capture and tame a capybara, peccary or tapir with the blowpipe, raise its trust to pet it, and keep a male and female of one species until they breed.

roadmap.title: Spirits of Amazonia
roadmap.description: Play the Spirits of Amazonia campaign end to end. Discover each village, build 800 trust with all three tribes, complete every area legend, run the three trials plus the final Yabahuaca trial, finish the side counters and maps, report back to base, and finish the story for the meta achievement.

achievements.summary: Finish the opening tutorial on any difficulty.

steps.text: Complete the guided opening objectives until the tutorial hands control of the jungle to Jake.

guide.context: The scripted story rituals count for this achievement.

steps.text: Collect @item{banisteriopsis vine} from a @loc{Brazil-nut tree} and @item{psychotria} from the small red-berried plant.
Build a small fire under a @item{ceremonial pot} and drink the brew it produces.

achievements.description: Finish the story without the cure.
achievements.summary: Reach the story's ending without having crafted the cure.

steps.text: Play the story to the final ayahuasca ritual at the @loc{large native settlement} without crafting the cure.
Answer @npc{Mia} that the cure was not obtained and watch the ending.
steps.note: A manual save at the research lab camp before the ritual lets the other ending be reloaded from the same run.

achievements.description: Finish the story with the cure.
achievements.summary: Reach the story's ending while carrying the cure.

steps.text: Craft the @item{cure} and keep it in the backpack.
Perform the final ayahuasca ritual at the @loc{large native settlement}.
Tell @npc{Mia} the cure was obtained and finish the ending.
steps.note: A manual save at the research lab camp beforehand lets you reload for the no-cure ending.

achievements.description: Complete Story mode on any difficulty with gold sack in backpack
achievements.summary: Finish Story mode carrying the @item{gold sack} in the backpack.

guide.context: The sack weighs 1 kg and the story can be completed without ever picking it up.

steps.text: Take the @item{gold sack} from the table in the calendar building of the @loc{illegal gold mine} on the west side of the map (reported near 40W 15S).
Keep the sack in the backpack until the story ends.

achievements.description: Finish the game on Green Hell difficulty level
achievements.summary: Finish the story on the Green Hell difficulty preset.

guide.context: Green Hell is permanent death, so the whole story must be completed without dying; nutrients and ailments also drain faster at this preset.

steps.text: Start a story run with the @mechanic{Green Hell} difficulty preset selected.
Complete the campaign and finish the final ritual without dying.
steps.note: The ayahuasca rituals reset Jake's status and act as recovery points. Keep extra saves at a shelter, because dying discards the run.

steps.text: Walk, run and explore until the travel counter reaches 64 km; every mode and playthrough adds to the total.
Craft a @item{small fire} or @item{campfire} and light it with a fire-starting tool.

achievements.summary: Survive one full night in the jungle.

steps.text: Stay alive from the opening of any mode until the first sunrise.

achievements.description: Survive 10 days on King of the Jungle difficulty or higher
achievements.summary: Survive 10 in-game days at @mechanic{King of the Jungle} difficulty or above.

guide.context: The difficulty preset must stay at King of the Jungle or Green Hell for the whole run.

steps.text: Keep Jake alive on that save for 10 in-game days.
Let Jake die to any cause in any mode.
Kill a tribesman, harvest @item{human meat} from the body, and eat it.
steps.note: Eating it costs a large amount of sanity.

steps.text: Attack any tribal warrior with a weapon until he dies.
Craft any tool, such as a @item{stone axe}.

achievements.description: Survive 25 days solely on mushroom and plant-based food on Welcome to the Jungle difficulty or higher
achievements.summary: Survive 25 in-game days eating only mushroom and plant-based food at @mechanic{Welcome to the Jungle} difficulty or above.

guide.context: No meat of any kind during the run, and protein and fat are the hardest nutrients to keep supplied.

steps.text: Start a run at Welcome to the Jungle difficulty or above and eat only plants and mushrooms.
Keep protein, fat and carbohydrates supplied for 25 in-game days.
steps.note: Brazil nuts are a reliable fat source and @item{Monstera Deliciosa fruit} a reliable protein source.

achievements.description: Survive 10 days on King of the Jungle difficulty or higher without killing animals, humans, destroying bee nests and interacting with traps
achievements.summary: Survive 10 in-game days at @mechanic{King of the Jungle} difficulty or above without killing animals or humans, destroying bee nests, or touching traps.

guide.context: Already-dead animals may still be eaten or harvested; only killing and the three listed interactions are restricted.

steps.text: Start a run at King of the Jungle difficulty or above.
For 10 in-game days, do not kill any creature or tribesman, break a bee nest, or interact with a trap.

guide.context: Wilson sits on the far west coast where the shoreline appears to end.

steps.text: Walk the far west coast south past the large rock (reported near 54W 26S) and pick up the @item{Wilson} ball on the shore.

achievements.summary: Reach the maximum level of any skill.

steps.text: Keep gathering, chopping and fighting with one weapon type; the @mechanic{axe} skill fills fastest.

achievements.description: Create and wear a full metal armor set
achievements.summary: Craft and wear a full set of metal armor.

guide.context: A full set covers every limb and takes 6 melted iron for the molds. Worn metal armor adds no carry weight.

steps.text: Mine @item{iron ore} from cave veins with a @item{stone pickaxe} or @item{metal pickaxe}, or melt empty cans.
Unlock the @item{mud forge} blueprint, then smelt the iron into melted iron.
Craft 6 @item{armor molds} from an empty mold, 1 melted iron and 1 stick, then bake and harvest each one for 2 armor casts.
Combine 3 armor casts with 2 rope and 1 banana leaf for each limb and wear all four pieces.

achievements.description: Save your game in a shelter
achievements.summary: Save the game inside a shelter.

steps.text: Build any shelter and sleep in it to save.

achievements.description: Find the mushroom that started it all.
achievements.summary: Pick up the green mushroom in the flooded cave.

steps.text: Use the @item{grappling hook} near the main village (reported near 34W 34S) and follow the path into the cave.
Keep to the right wall going deeper, swim through the flooded tunnel and take the @item{green mushroom} at the water's edge.
steps.note: The mushroom is poisonous and cannot be eaten safely.

guide.context: Hallucinations appear once sanity drops below 20. They are hostile and vanish from any damage.

steps.text: Let sanity fall below 20 by eating human meat, skipping sleep, or letting ailments run.
Attack a hallucinated tribesman until it bursts.
Wade through water or vegetation to pick up leeches, then open the inspection menu and drag each leech off a body part.

achievements.description: Let maggots eat your infected wound
achievements.summary: Let maggots feed on an infected wound.

guide.context: An infection is a wound left unbandaged until yellow pus appears; staying dirty speeds this up.

steps.text: Leave a wound unbandaged until it becomes infected.
Drag @item{maggots} from a rotting carcass or rotting meat onto the infected wound.
Build any shelter; a modular frame needs a @item{palm roof} or @item{banana roof} before it counts.

achievements.summary: Craft the cure at the research lab.

guide.context: Picking up the poison dart frog applies heavy poison and a fever; bring dressings and use the camp tents to sleep it off.

steps.text: At the @loc{research lab} (reported near 25W 33S), take the @item{infected blood sample} from the refrigerator.
Put the blood sample into the machine.
Catch a @item{poison dart frog} and add it to the machine.
Collect the finished @item{cure}.

achievements.summary: Drink water that has been made safe.

steps.text: Fill a @item{coconut shell}, @item{turtle shell} or @item{metal pot} with rainwater, or boil water in it over a fire, then drink.

guide.context: Sleeping, or passing out from exhaustion, clears the stacks.

steps.text: Do not sleep, and keep energy high enough that Jake does not pass out.
Eat high-energy food while waiting: @item{coffee} gives 15, while @item{blue mushroom} and @item{Monstera Deliciosa fruit} give 10 each.

achievements.description: Keep a single fire burning for over 5 days on Welcome to the jungle difficulty or higher
achievements.summary: Keep one fire burning for more than 5 in-game days at @mechanic{Welcome to the Jungle} difficulty or above.

guide.context: A campfire burns about 20 in-game hours per fill; a small fire burns about 12, or about 15 with a stone ring. Only the one fire has to stay lit.

steps.text: Build a @item{campfire} or @item{small fire} under a roof or inside a cave so rain cannot put it out.
Refuel it with @item{sticks}, @item{planks}, @item{dry leaves} and similar burnables until it has burned for more than 5 in-game days.

achievements.description: Make tortoise soup in it's shell
achievements.summary: Cook tortoise soup inside its shell.

steps.text: Find a @enemy{red-footed tortoise} in a riverbed and harvest it with a blade for the @item{turtle shell} and @item{turtle meat}.
Put the shell on a fire, fill it with safe water using a @item{bidon}, then add the turtle meat once the water is warm.

guide.context: Bait, traps and spears are interchangeable; the nine listed creatures are a complete set.

collectibles.name: Angelfish
collectibles.method: Bait a fishing line with a maggot.

collectibles.name: Arowana
collectibles.method: Kill it with a spear.

collectibles.name: Discus fish
collectibles.method: Bait a fishing line with a Brazil nut.

collectibles.name: Peacock bass
collectibles.method: Bait a fishing line trap with a larva.

collectibles.name: Red-bellied piranha
collectibles.method: Bait a fishing rod trap with a larva.

collectibles.name: River stingray
collectibles.method: Kill it with a spear.

collectibles.name: Prawn
collectibles.method: Use a prawn trap.

collectibles.name: Red crab
collectibles.method: Kill it with a spear.

collectibles.name: Mystery snail
collectibles.method: Pick it up by hand.

achievements.description: Hunt a Rattlesnake, Jaguar, Puma, Caiman and 3 types of arachnids
achievements.summary: Hunt a rattlesnake, jaguar, puma, black caiman and three kinds of arachnid.

guide.context: Kill one of each listed creature; the three arachnids are the Brazilian wandering spider, the goliath birdeater and the scorpion.

collectibles.name: South American rattlesnake
collectibles.method: Kill it with a spear or arrows.

collectibles.name: Jaguar
collectibles.method: Kill it with a bow or spear.

collectibles.name: Puma
collectibles.method: Kill it with a bow or spear.

collectibles.name: Black caiman
collectibles.method: Kill it with a spear.

collectibles.name: Brazilian wandering spider
collectibles.method: Kill it with any weapon.

collectibles.name: Goliath birdeater spider
collectibles.method: Kill it with any weapon.

collectibles.name: Scorpion
collectibles.method: Kill it with any weapon.

achievements.displayName: Do you want to play with a snowman?
achievements.description: Find a snowman package in 3 different locations
achievements.summary: Collect a snowman package at 3 separate locations.

guide.context: Three fixed packages exist; each one is simply approached and picked up.

collectibles.name: Drug Facility package
collectibles.method: Climb the front planks, turn right past the microwave, and take the package from the table.

collectibles.name: Cave package
collectibles.location: Cave south-west of the Drug Facility, reported near 52W 29S
collectibles.method: Enter the cave, follow the path to the junction and take the left tunnel to the camp.

collectibles.name: Airport package
collectibles.method: Check the small shed beside the main radio building.

guide.context: The tribal firestarter must be found in the world before it can be crafted.

steps.text: Craft the @item{hand drill} from 1 stick and 1 small stick.
Craft the @item{hand drill plank} from 1 stick and 1 plank.
Craft the @item{fire bow} from a bow, a stone, a small stick and a plank.
Pick up a @item{tribal firestarter} at the western native village (reported near 47W 17S), then craft one from 2 sticks and 2 rope.

achievements.displayName: Mr... I don't feel so good
achievements.description: At the same time get leeches, worm, rash, fever, poison, food poisoning, parasites, insomnia, dirt and any wound
achievements.summary: Have leeches, a worm, a rash, a fever, poison, food poisoning, insomnia, parasites, dirt and a wound all active at once.

guide.context: Only one ailment fits per limb, so each new condition needs a free body part; save-reload loops control which limb receives each one.

steps.text: Prepare at an @loc{ant hill} with a shelter, medicine and manual saves between each step.
Skip sleep until insomnia stacks, eating energy food so Jake does not pass out.
Wade through water or vegetation until a leech attaches.
Sleep briefly on the ground to pick up a worm on a free limb.
Touch the ant hill to take a rash on another limb.
Get dirty by harvesting an animal or taking mud.
Take a snake bite for poison, which usually adds a fever as well.
Eat raw or rotten meat to add food poisoning and parasites.
Take one more wound while all ten conditions are still active.

achievements.summary: Experience all 12 unique diseases and wounds.

guide.context: The twelve are an infection, food poisoning, fever, worms, a venom wound, a laceration, a scratch or abrasion, a rash, parasites, leeches, insomnia and low sanity.

steps.text: Catch each of the twelve at least once; most arrive during normal survival, and low sanity counts as one of them.

achievements.displayName: I'm not afraid of any work

guide.context: Challenges are short standalone scenarios started from the main menu, so supplies do not carry between attempts.

steps.text: Finish the @mechanic{Campfire Challenge}, stocking many stone axes.
Finish the @mechanic{Raft Challenge} by building the raft and loading 24 coconuts.
Finish the @mechanic{Mighty Camp Challenge}; build two fires for charcoal and collect the bamboo logs from the crashed plane site near 40W 23S.
Finish the @mechanic{Hunter Challenge} with a spear and bow, hunting the required animals wherever they spawn.
Finish the @mechanic{Fisherman Challenge} by catching the snail and stingray in the spawn river and the prawn and lake fish around Anaconda Island.
Finish the @mechanic{Radio Challenge}; craft bandages, weapons and armor before the fights.
Finish the @mechanic{Blacksmith Challenge}; base near wood, build charcoal furnaces and smelters, and smelt iron from ore or cans.

guide.context: About 15 plants can be cultivated, the same planter can be reused, and a crop only has to reach full growth.

steps.text: Plant 12 distinct cultivatable crops one after another and wait for each to stop growing; sleeping speeds growth.
Sweep the map edges and revisit every named hub until 60 map markers are discovered.

guide.context: Collectibles are the readable notes found around the map in Story mode.

steps.text: Pick up and read notes in camps, labs and side shacks while working through the story.

achievements.description: Gain 800 trust of the Mu'agi tribe

guide.context: Trust comes from returning children and kidnapped women (30 each), healing injured hunters (30), burning corpses (20), destroying camps (5 small, 40 large) and finishing area legends (100 each).

steps.text: Work the Mu'agi area tasks around the village (reported near 41W 35S) until the tribe trust counter reaches 800.

achievements.description: Gain 800 trust of the Un'garaca tribe

guide.context: Trust comes from returning children and kidnapped women (30 each), healing injured hunters (30), destroying camps (5 small, 40 large), finishing area legends (100 each) and clearing polluted water sources (25).

steps.text: Work the Un'garaca area tasks around the village (reported near 46W 26S) until the tribe trust counter reaches 800.

achievements.description: Gain 800 trust of the Habbacu tribe

guide.context: Trust comes from helping tribal fishermen (25), rebuilding totems (25), destroying camps (5 small, 40 large) and finishing area legends (100 each), plus the shared tribe tasks as they appear.

steps.text: Work the Habbacu area tasks around the village (reported near 25W 21S) until the tribe trust counter reaches 800.

achievements.summary: Return 9 lost children to a tribal village.

guide.context: Children flee when approached, so each one must be caught and carried back to a village.

steps.text: Find the fleeing children across the SoA map and carry each one to a tribal village until 9 have been returned.

guide.context: The item needed depends on the injury, and it is handed over by dragging it from the inventory onto the tribesman.

steps.text: Find an injured tribesman, read his injury, and apply the matching dressing, clean water or mushroom.

guide.context: Corpses hang from trees in the first SoA area and must be cut down before they can be burned.

steps.text: Cut a hanging body down with a blade, gather the materials the game asks for, prepare it and burn it; repeat 10 times.

guide.context: The poisoned water in the second SoA area is bright green, and the bottles are taken from the water itself.

steps.text: Collect the toxin bottles from the green water, build a fire and burn them; repeat 10 times.

guide.context: Each fisherman asks by dialogue for one specific item.

steps.text: Bring fishermen the requested items, such as a bamboo bow, arrows, a four-pronged spear, larva or clean water, until 5 have been helped.

guide.context: A totem needs bones, rope, small sticks, long sticks, feathers and a tapir skull.

steps.text: Find broken totems in the third SoA area, supply the materials and rebuild each one until 10 are done.

guide.context: Caged women are held at enemy camps, and the guards have to be cleared before the cage can be opened.

steps.text: Clear an enemy camp, open the cage door, and repeat until 9 women are released.

collectibles.name: Map 1
collectibles.method: Search the boat's interior and take the map.

collectibles.name: Map 2
collectibles.method: Search the facility buildings for the map.

collectibles.name: Map 3
collectibles.method: Take the map from the basket or box in the airport.

collectibles.name: Map 4
collectibles.method: Search the lower part of the airport for the second map.

collectibles.name: Map 5
collectibles.method: Search the tent for the map.

achievements.description: Complete the Spirits of Amazonia story
achievements.summary: Complete the Spirits of Amazonia story.

guide.context: The campaign spans the three tribe areas and the fifth-map Yabahuaca sequence before returning to the boat.

steps.text: Play the Spirits of Amazonia campaign to its ending and return to the boat.

achievements.summary: Report back to base from the boat radio.

steps.text: At the boat (reported near 40W 40S) on the first SoA map, burn the dead captain's body.
Take the @item{antenna} from the back of the jeep at the drug facility (reported near 51W 27S).
Fit the antenna to the boat radio and make the report.

guide.context: Reach 800 Mu'agi trust, take the ritual herbs from the elder, and start the ritual at the village bowl with a fire beneath it.

steps.text: Protect the injured hunters from predators while growing the correct curing plant and depositing the giant water droplets.

guide.context: Reach 800 Habbacu trust, take the ritual herbs from the elder, and start the ritual at the village bowl with a fire beneath it.

steps.text: Collect the green, blue and yellow mystical fish from inside the red piranha swarms without being caught, using air bubbles to avoid drowning.

guide.context: Reach 800 Un'garaca trust, take the ritual herbs from the elder, and start the ritual at the village bowl with a fire beneath it.

steps.text: Hunt the animals shown on the trial rock using the weapon type given for each one.
Reach the Yabahuaca village on the fifth SoA map (reported near 31W 36S).

guide.context: The route opens after the three tribe ritual tokens have been earned.

steps.text: Build the improved trust tokens in the three @loc{Moon Cave} furnaces, lighting a small fire under each furnace.
Repair the boat with @item{tree resin} and return to the warrior.
Place the finished tokens in the totem to start the final ritual.
Survive the ritual enemies as the fog closes in and reach the passage.
Reach the Mu'agi village in the first SoA area (reported near 41W 35S).
Reach the Habbacu village in the third SoA area (reported near 25W 21S).
Reach the Un'garaca village in the second SoA area (reported near 46W 26S).

guide.context: Every legend needs all of its inscribed stones read before its objective can be solved, and each finished legend grants 100 trust.

steps.text: Finish the Cursed Water, Howling Spirit, White Demon and Craftsman legends.

guide.context: The Dance of Death ends in a cave fight after turtle meat is offered on the altar across three days.

steps.text: Finish the Blood Tears, Gifts of the Jungle and Dance of Death legends.

guide.context: The Guardians ends with three clay monkey figurines placed at their marked spots, and the Fish of Fortune ends by baiting a marked trap.

steps.text: Finish the Fish of Fortune, Guardians, Death Bringer and Spirit Eater legends.

achievements.description: Complete all Spirits of Amazonia achievements
achievements.summary: Earn every other Spirits of Amazonia achievement.

guide.context: This meta entry needs all three tribes' trust, trials and legends plus every SoA side counter, so it always unlocks last.

steps.text: Complete every remaining Spirits of Amazonia achievement.

achievements.description: Put an animal into Animal Pen
achievements.summary: Put a live animal into an Animal Pen.

guide.context: The pen blueprint unlocks by crafting a bamboo blowpipe or catching a small animal in a snare trap.

steps.text: Build an @item{Animal Pen} and add a feeding trough and a water trough.
Craft a @item{blowpipe} from 1 long bamboo stick and 2 rope, poison darts with a @item{poison dart frog}, and knock out a @enemy{capybara}, @enemy{peccary} or @enemy{tapir}.
Tie the sleeping animal with @item{rope}, carry it inside the pen, drop it and untie it.

guide.context: Petting raises the animal's trust and gives a +10 sanity boost.

steps.text: Feed and water a penned animal until the pet option appears, then look at the animal head-on and press E.

guide.context: Breeding needs a male and a female of the same species kept together with high trust.

steps.text: Keep one male and one female of the same species in a clean, fed and watered pen.
Raise their trust to breeding level and wait several in-game days for the offspring.
